title.narrative: Ethiopia Interfaith Initiative 4 Forest Conservation & Climate Action - NICFI 2021-25

description.narrative:
The project will build on a pilot project to conserve church forests supported by the Norwegian embassy in Ethiopia. The project aims to contriibute to rehabilitation and conservation of 28 750 hectares of forest, reach up to 21 million people to follow laws protecting forests through awareness and mobilisation campaigns and directly benefit 95 000 people dependent on forests. This will be done by applying the church forest methodology developed in the pilot, drawing lessons from six Ethiopian Orthodox churches and further strengthening the Ethiopia Interfaith Climate Platform (EICP) established in the pilot and ensure this is functioning and advocating for change in, and implementation of climate and forest policies and strategies.
Main outcomes are:
1. Sacred forests are included into Ethiopian forest legislation and policies 2. Faith leaders and faith communities have mobilised communities to respect and follow the theological rationale and government policy for forest protection 3. Forests are conserved, and green corridors are established 4. Communities have improved livelihoods without adding pressure on the forest resources 5. Project lessons and learnings shared and practiced at local and global
The project will have an interreligious approach and work together with the following local implementing partners:
• The Ethiopian Orthodox Church Development and Inter Church Aid Commission (EOC-DICAC) • The Ethiopian Evangelical Church Mekane Yesus Development and Social Services Commission (EECMY DASSC) • Ethiopian Muslims’ Relief and Development Association (EMRDA)
In addition, The World Agroforestry Center (ICRAF) will be a resource partner.
The project will also work to increase women's participation in local and national decision-making structures and ensure equal participation of women in emergency task forces and in climate resilient assessments. Community disaster risk management plans will be made and regularly updated.
